subject.title: [Bug]: Agent heartbeat routes to wrong agent's session instead of its own

question: Should maintainers accept the open fix PR's agent-scoped runtime ownership model for global heartbeat sessions after exact-head validation?
rationale: The issue has a clear source-level bug and a proof-positive fix candidate, but the repair deliberately changes internal heartbeat, reply-run, embedded-lane, and event-queue ownership for global sessions.

options.title: Refresh and land the fix PR
options.body: Rebase or merge current main into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102307, require exact-head checks, and land if the same two-agent global-scope proof still holds.

options.title: Require one more live proof run
options.body: Ask for a fresh real Gateway run on the final merge head before landing because the affected behavior is session-state-sensitive.

options.title: Pause for a broader session design
options.body: Hold the PR only if maintainers want a different permanent model for selected-agent global runtime ownership.

recommendation.title: Refresh and land the fix PR
recommendation.body: Rebase or merge current main into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102307, require exact-head checks, and land if the same two-agent global-scope proof still holds.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the main fixup commits and is the strongest available owner for the session-state merge-risk decision.
